external_fixture_policy: Keep upstream stimulus, load, bias, reference and fixed transistor blocks outside the DUT unless explicitly redefined and revalidated.
area_policy: After electrical acceptance, minimize GDS bounding area; the benchmark fixed-effective-area utilization policy is configured centrally, not reconstructed from the upstream circuit-sizing score.
qualification_scope: Original physical DUT passes the one supplied public transient. Native resistor DRC/LVS controls and extracted-model binding qualified without changing the DUT, PDK or process rules. This is not a complete-circuit layout or full original SPEC pass.

substrate_connection.policy: Preserve every resolved MOS body net. Identifying a ground port does not authorize tying other body nets to it. Non-ground NMOS body nets need an explicit isolated-well strategy and PDK/PCell/LVS regression.

substrate_basis: All flattened NMOS bulk terminals connect to this declared top port.
